verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת־ טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃ אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־ עֵ֑ת תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ תָּ֝מִ֗יד בְּפִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·šan·nō·w·ṯōw ’eṯ- ṭa‘·mōw lip̄·nê ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ way·ḡā·ră·šê·hū way·yê·laḵ ’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ tə·hil·lā·ṯōw tā·mîḏ bə·p̄î
verses.literal: Of David when he pretended - to be insane before Abimelech so that [the king] drove him away I will bless - the LORD at all times His praise will always be on my lips

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֑י תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל בַּ֭יהוָה עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî tiṯ·hal·lêl Yah·weh ‘ă·nā·wîm yiš·mə·‘ū wə·yiś·mā·ḥū
verses.literal: My soul boasts in the LORD let the oppressed hear and rejoice

verses.original: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: gad·də·lū Yah·weh ’it·tî ū·nə·rō·wm·māh šə·mōw yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Magnify the LORD with me let us exalt His name together

verses.original: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי הִצִּילָֽנִי׃ וּמִכָּל־ מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י
verses.transliteration: dā·raš·tî ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·‘ā·nā·nî hiṣ·ṣî·lā·nî ū·mik·kāl- mə·ḡū·rō·w·ṯay
verses.literal: I sought - the LORD and He answered me He delivered me from all my fears

verses.original: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־ יֶחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hib·bî·ṭū ’ê·lāw wə·nā·hā·rū ū·p̄ə·nê·hem ’al- yeḥ·pā·rū
verses.literal: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy their faces shall never be ashamed

verses.original: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ׃ וּמִכָּל־ צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: zeh ‘ā·nî qā·rā Yah·weh šā·mê·a‘ hō·wō·šî·‘ōw ū·mik·kāl- ṣā·rō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: This poor man called out and the LORD heard him He saved him from all his troubles

verses.original: מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֓ה חֹנֶ֤ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh ḥō·neh sā·ḇîḇ lî·rê·’āw way·ḥal·lə·ṣêm
verses.literal: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him and he delivers them

verses.original: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי־ יְהוָ֑ה ט֣וֹב אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭa·‘ă·mū ū·rə·’ū kî- Yah·weh ṭō·wḇ ’aš·rê hag·ge·ḇer ye·ḥĕ·seh- bōw
verses.literal: Taste and see that the LORD is good blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him

verses.original: יְר֣אוּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי־ לִירֵאָֽיו׃ מַ֝חְס֗וֹר אֵ֥ין
verses.transliteration: yə·r·’ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh qə·ḏō·šāw kî- lî·rê·’āw maḥ·sō·wr ’ên
verses.literal: Fear - the LORD you His saints for those who fear Him lack nothing

verses.original: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יַחְסְר֥וּ לֹא־ כָל־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: kə·p̄î·rîm rā·šū wə·rā·‘ê·ḇū wə·ḏō·rə·šê Yah·weh yaḥ·sə·rū lō- ḵāl ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Young lions go lacking and hungry but those who seek the LORD lack no . . . good thing

verses.original: לְֽכוּ־ בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם׃ יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū- ḇā·nîm šim·‘ū- lî ’ă·lam·meḏ·ḵem yir·’aṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Come children listen to me I will teach you the fear of the LORD

verses.original: מִֽי־ הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃ יָ֝מִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: mî- hā·’îš he·ḥā·p̄êṣ ḥay·yîm ’ō·hêḇ lir·’ō·wṯ ṭō·wḇ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Who is the man who delights in life who desires to see good days

verses.original: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִרְמָֽה׃ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר
verses.transliteration: nə·ṣōr lə·šō·wn·ḵā mê·rā‘ ū·śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā mir·māh mid·dab·bêr
verses.literal: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech

verses.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: sūr mê·rā‘ wa·‘ă·śêh- ṭō·wḇ baq·qêš šā·lō·wm wə·rā·ḏə·p̄ê·hū
verses.literal: Turn away from evil and do good seek peace and pursue it

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל־ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל־ שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nê Yah·weh ’el- ṣad·dî·qîm wə·’ā·zə·nāw ’el- šaw·‘ā·ṯām
verses.literal: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous and His ears are inclined to their cry

verses.original: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית זִכְרָֽם׃ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ
verses.transliteration: pə·nê Yah·weh bə·‘ō·śê rā‘ lə·haḵ·rîṯ ziḵ·rām mê·’e·reṣ
verses.literal: [But] the face of the LORD is against those who do evil to wipe out [all] memory of them from the earth

verses.original: צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ הִצִּילָֽם׃ וּמִכָּל־ צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם
verses.transliteration: ṣā·‘ă·qū Yah·weh šā·mê·a‘ hiṣ·ṣî·lām ū·mik·kāl- ṣā·rō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: The righteous cry out and the LORD hears He delivers them from all their troubles

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה קָר֣וֹב לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־ לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת־ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃ דַּכְּאֵי־ ר֥וּחַ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh qā·rō·wḇ lə·niš·bə·rê- lêḇ wə·’eṯ- yō·wō·šî·a‘ dak·kə·’ê- rū·aḥ
verses.literal: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted . . . - He saves the contrite in spirit

verses.original: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק יְהוָֽה׃ יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם
verses.transliteration: rab·bō·wṯ rā·‘ō·wṯ ṣad·dîq Yah·weh yaṣ·ṣî·len·nū ū·mik·kul·lām
verses.literal: Many [are] the afflictions of the righteous but the LORD delivers him from them all

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל־ עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו לֹ֣א אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה נִשְׁבָּֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: šō·mêr kāl- ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw lō ’a·ḥaṯ mê·hên·nāh niš·bā·rāh
verses.literal: He protects all his bones not one of them will be broken

verses.original: רָעָ֑ה תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·‘āh tə·mō·w·ṯêṯ rā·šā‘ wə·śō·nə·’ê ṣad·dîq ye’·šā·mū
verses.literal: Evil {will} slay the wicked and the haters of the righteous will be condemned

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה פּוֹדֶ֣ה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו כָּֽל־ וְלֹ֥א הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃ יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh pō·w·ḏeh ne·p̄eš ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw kāl- wə·lō ha·ḥō·sîm bōw ye’·šə·mū
verses.literal: The LORD redeems - His servants and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned
